column1: # tip: 83e1125 (devel: forward_pre keeps the activations on one band); pre: 961308b (it leaves them empty). 2026-11-12, 09:57 to 10:08, an idle machine
# (started after five quiet minutes, mains power, the `performance` profile, nobody at it and the panel off), Bend 2.0.40, bend-ml-tensor-array@0.1.20.0.
# gen <dir> <prompt> 1: first_ms is the program's own clock from the start of the prompt to the first new token. One thread is pinned (taskset -c 3) and
# counted by perf stat (cpu_core/instructions/u, cpu_core/cycles/u, the whole run); the 135M on 16 threads is the control. state still: nothing else on
# the machine. state changing: a desktop notification replaced about 30 times a second. token_bits: sha256 of the prompt ids, the token and its logit bits.
# The uncore columns are empty: its frequency file was not readable.
